n1:FATCAFileErrorNotification.NotificationContentTxt: The IRS could not download the referenced file that had been posted to IDES. Your certificate posted to IDES was not valid. Please do not submit a request to correct, amend or void any of the records in this file until you receive a notification that this file has been received as valid. For more information on this notification, please see: http://www.irs.gov/Businesses/Corporations/FATCA-Error-Notifications

ActionRequestedGrp.ActionRequestedTxt: Please post an updated certificate and resubmit the file to IDES.
ActionRequestedGrp.ActionRequestedDueDateTxt: Your organization’s due date for filing Form 8966.

n1:FATCAFileErrorNotification.HCTATreatyStampTxt: This information is furnished under the provisions of an income tax treaty, tax information exchange agreement (TIEA), or other agreement for the exchange of information with a foreign government, and its use and disclosure must be governed by the provisions of that treaty, TIEA, or other agreement.
